recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a male figure emerging from absolute darkness. The subject's face is partially obscured by a hand held horizontally across the lower half, with light catching the texture of the skin, the glint of the eyes, and the sparkle of iced-out jewelry on the wrist and neck.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme contrast between deep shadows and warm skin highlights
The hand acts as a secondary focal point, framing the eyes
Sparkling jewelry provides high-frequency visual noise against smooth dark areas
Vertical dreadlocks create a rhythmic frame for the face
coreInvariants: Visible skin texture and pore detail in highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, positioned just above the horizontal midline of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright jewelry on the wrist, moves left across the hand to the eyes, then down to the chain at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black space surrounding the head and filling the bottom corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for atmosphere and depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and copper tones for skin highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool white and silver for jewelry reflections and catchlights in the eyes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall, with high value contrast in the highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a felt-tip marker
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lower case 'i' with a simple dot
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between raw, organic handwriting and a formal, structured advisory logo.
graphicDevices: Standardized content advisory block in bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, personal feel of the original lettering.
Provides a similar balance of legibility and organic form.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a low-key portrait of a man with dreadlocks in extreme close-up. Light him from the side so half his face is in shadow. He should have his hand raised across his mouth. Focus on the texture of the skin and the sparkle of a large diamond watch on his wrist. The background must be solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add handwritten white text in the bottom right corner using a marker-style stroke. Add a standard black and white parental advisory logo in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting dramatic and directional?
Does the jewelry have a realistic 'iced-out' sparkle?
Is the text in the bottom right corner organic and handwritten?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the hand across the face
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the eyes and jewelry

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'halo' artifacts around the subject against the black background
Ensure the jewelry reflections don't look like generic white dots
Verify the handwritten text looks natural and not like a standard font
Confirm the eyes have a sharp catchlight
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key lighting + Centralized subject + Obscured face + High-value jewelry accents + Minimalist handwritten typography.
